greeting: Chronos Present on comms. Stage 3: Healing the Flow. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running Against Time. Objective drift gets teams buried.
The compass spun, laughed, and still pointed exactly where we needed to go.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Channel the five Crystals' power.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Channel the five Crystals' power; Heal the temporal wound; Merge the three aspects. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Use the five Crystals to reunite the Chronos Guardian. Immediate move: Channel the five Crystals' power.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 3 resolved: Healing the Flow. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for The Future That Waits.
rumor: Citizens keep meeting tomorrow versions of themselves and borrowing bad advice.
People keep repeating one clue from Healing the Flow: 'Merge the three aspects'.
I catalog omens by flavor now. Today tastes like burnt citrus and bad decisions.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn loops are usually stable. Mark your path or the street will rearrange you.
dialog.time_noon: Noon produces the most timeline echoes. Do not chase every duplicate signal.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk is paradox weather. If a clock runs backward, leave it alone.
dialog.time_night: Night splits voices from bodies. Use call-and-response to track your team.

party_reactions.kade: Chronos Present sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Chronos Present accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Chronos Present talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: Identify your lane and your fallback.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Good timing. We can still salvage this window.
relationship_dialog.friend: You know the drill. I trust your judgment.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: If the world bends, we bend it back together.
